body.x: SILLA ENC will participate in the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its smart parking and smart farm.

Since its establishment in June 2008, SILLA ENC has been the cornerstone of the development of Korea's Internet with wired/wireless network communication and software development and additional communication services, and has contributed to creating a global IT network.

An official said, "We developed service technology suitable for smart city and smart farm for Industry 4.0. We will make another leap forward to lead Industry 4.0 with the spirit of innovation and challenge to open a new era.” He continued, “We will create new value through network, software, and intelligent smart solutions, and grow on the world stage."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
